name: Twisting Vines
source:
In Twisting Vines you’re a young man who’s living on his own and enjoys life, going out with girls and having a nice time. But all this changes as you get an unexpected roommate! How will your lives entwine? Will your usual life style suffer, will it give you a different outlook on life and relationships or will you develop feeling for your new flat mate? Find out NOW in Twisting Vines!
It’s a first person visual novel game, which aims to be a more realistic and fun experience. You’ll have plenty of choices to make and all of them impact the course of the game.
